children: The rising trend of CBOT grain futures was challenged overnight, with the row crop complex lower in pre-market trade. The pullback is expected, but may be temporary, says Naomi Blohm of Total Farm Marketing in a note. "All are overbought on daily charts," says Blohm, adding that even with that being the case, the market still has potential to rise further. Monday's Crop Progress report from the USDA showed mostly steady crop conditions, with 57% of the U.S. corn crop remaining in good-or-excellent condition, unchanged from last week. Soybean condition fell two points, to 58% good-or-excellent. Overnight, corn futures sink 1.5%, soybeans drop 1.1%, and wheat is down 0.9%. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
